items.text: Approving various routine parking- and traffic modifications: (The Planning Department has found that Items A-B are exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act [CEQA]. For these parking and traffic modifications that received a categorical exemption, the proposed SFMTA Board action constitutes the Approval Action as defined by Chapter 31 of the San Francisco Administrative Code. Explanatory documents include a staff report and resolution.) A. B. ESTABLISH - RESIDENTIAL PERMIT PARKING AREA C 600 block of Geary Street between Leavenworth Street and Jones Street. C. ESTABLISH – GENERAL METERED PARKING, 2-HOUR TIME LIMIT, 9 AM TO 6 PM, MONDAY THROUGH SATURDAY, 26th Avenue, west side, from 29 feet to 100 feet north of Geary Boulevard. 4 D.
